aiTutorDisclaimerLong:
Our new AI Tutor can help you think through new ideas, debug your code, and learn along the way! You can ask it questions about your project or the concepts you’re exploring.

Just remember, AI isn’t human and not perfect. Sometimes it might make mistakes or give answers that don’t quite make sense. Always make sure to use your own judgment, double-check any AI advice, and don’t be afraid to experiment.

All messages you send will be visible to your teacher, including blocked messages. Inappropriate messages will be flagged by our content moderation policy. In order to protect your privacy, anything considered personal information (name, phone number, address, etc.) should not be submitted.
